source.text: At the start of your Shooting phase, select one **visible** enemy **VEHICLE** unit. Until the end of the phase, each time a friendly **HERETIC ASTARTES** model makes an attack that targets that unit, re-roll a **Wound roll** of 1.

judgement.when: Picked by the Warpsmith’s Master of Mechanisms in your Command phase (within 3")
judgement.note: that VEHICLE model’s attacks have +1 to hit rolls until the start of your next Command phase

source.text: In your Command phase, select one friendly **HERETIC ASTARTES VEHICLE** model within 3" of this model. That **VEHICLE** model regains up to D3 lost wounds and, until the start of your next Command phase, each time that **VEHICLE** makes an attack, add 1 to the **Hit roll**. Each model can only be selected for this ability once per Command phase.
In your Shooting phase, when this unit is selected to shoot, you can use this ability. If you do, this unit's ranged attacks have **[INDIRECT FIRE]**.
